featured_reviews.name: Akanksha Vemul
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very disappointing experience with Naren Jewellers. I bought pure 24K gold from this shop about a month ago. Before purchasing, I clearly asked the owner about the resale value and whether there would be any deductions. He assured me multiple times, even on a phone call, that he would give the full selling price without any charges.

However, when I went back to sell the gold, the owner started deducting several percentages for his own profit. The price he offered was only around 60–70% of the actual gold value, which was completely different from what he had promised earlier.

This felt very misleading and dishonest. I have never had such a bad experience with any jeweller before. I later sold the same gold at another shop and received a much better and fair price.

Be careful before buying gold from here. I would not recommend this shop if you value transparency and fair dealing.
